title: Side setback, walls up to 3.5 m high (R30-R40)
text: C3.4.1 Buildings are set back from lot boundaries in accordance with Table 3.4a. Refer Figure 3.4a, b, c. Table 3.4a Lot boundary setbacks, side setback: R5 and above, Wall height up to 3.5m: 1m.

replaces.note: Part C Table 3.4a applied at R30-R40; 7.1 m+ 3 m -> 2 m (register ch3-057)

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: New to Chapter 3 as a separate record: the Chapter 2 R2-R40 rule allows the pedestrian access way reduction at R30-R40, Chapter 3 C3.4.1(ii) (p33) stops it at R25, so R30-R40 is tested without it. Rounding gap between bands unresolved. Applies only where the building has walls up to 3.5 m high (condition on building.has_walls_to_3_5m); the band does not depend on the building's maximum wall height.

verified.note: C3.4.1(ii) stops at R25 (p33), so R30-R40 has no pedestrian access way reduction.
